questions.prompt: You want your drink to go. What do you say?
questions.explanation: 포장해 주세요 asks for takeaway. 여기서 마실게요 means you will drink it here.

questions.prompt: Order your drink without ice. What do you say?
questions.explanation: 얼음 빼 주세요 asks to leave out the ice. 빼 주세요 asks for something to be removed or omitted.
